summary: Package resolves sole dependency from off-registry plain-HTTP tarball URL
details: jikaya-parser@1.0.1 declares its only dependency `marker-script-suffix-mapper` as a direct tarball URL `http://web.vitemaweed.fr:4873/marker-script-suffix-mapper/-/marker-script-suffix-mapper-1.0.18.tgz` in package.json rather than as a registry version range. `npm install` fetches that URL over plain HTTP and installs whatever bytes the host returns, with no version pin, no integrity hash, and no TLS, executing any lifecycle scripts inside the fetched tarball. The shipped index.js is a one-line stub and the package has empty author/description metadata, so the manifest line is the entire published surface. Whoever controls web.vitemaweed.fr:4873 — or any on-path attacker between the installer and that host — supplies arbitrary code that runs during installation.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
